Enum Class BuildingEachTurnType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<BuildingEachTurnType>
it.polimi.ingsw.model.enums.BuildingEachTurnType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<BuildingEachTurnType>, Constable
public enum BuildingEachTurnType extends Enum<BuildingEachTurnType>
Identifies the per-turn effect provided by a BuildingEachTurn card.

Each constant maps to a specific ongoing ability that activates at the start of the relevant game phase every round.
